answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can vote or earn rewards, and slash the bond when the identity is caught double-voting or spamming. The delta between an honest agent's earnings and a cheater's forfeited deposit is what makes the scheme work: a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for each fake identity, so the cost climbs like a mesa, a steep flat-topped wall, while honest agents share the open meadow of the economy at no extra cost. Scale stops paying once each puppet costs real money.
